priority_groups.description: Priority 1: Secure defaults and structured resolution

tests.name: config_loads_missing_file_with_secure_defaults
tests.description: A missing configuration resolves every skill to the secure hardcoded defaults
tests.arrange: Use a path that does not exist
tests.act: Load the configuration and resolve an unseen canonical skill
tests.assert: The immutable effective profile uses model SWE-1.7 and permission mode auto

tests.name: config_resolves_structured_defaults_and_exact_skill_override
tests.description: Structured defaults apply generally and only the exact canonical skill override is selected
tests.arrange: Configure defaults and distinct extract-story-intent and analyze-story overrides
tests.act: Resolve both configured skills and an unseen skill
tests.assert: Each configured skill receives only its exact override and the unseen skill receives defaults

tests.name: config_partial_override_inherits_each_unspecified_default_field
tests.description: Profile precedence is evaluated independently for model and permission mode
tests.arrange: Configure both defaults and an analyze-story override containing only permission_mode
tests.assert: The effective profile inherits the default model and uses the overridden permission mode

tests.name: config_maps_legacy_flat_fields_into_defaults
tests.description: Legacy flat configuration keeps its previous effective behavior
tests.arrange: Write a legacy file with flat model and permission_mode values
tests.act: Load it and resolve a canonical skill
tests.assert: The effective profile contains both legacy values

tests.name: config_mixed_format_uses_field_level_precedence
tests.description: Structured values override legacy values per field while omitted fields retain legacy fallback
tests.arrange: Write mixed structured and legacy defaults plus a partial skill override
tests.act: Resolve the overridden and unconfigured skills
tests.assert: Each field follows skill override, structured default, legacy default, then hardcoded default precedence

tests.name: run_skill_exposes_canonical_skill_in_invocation_context_without_changing_harness_contract
tests.description: An alternate Harness keeps run(prompt, cwd) while invocation code can read the canonical skill
tests.arrange: Use a fake alternate Harness that reads invocation context and writes the existing sentinel shape
tests.assert: The Harness observes the input skill name, receives only prompt and cwd, and output is read from verify_params

tests.name: invocation_context_resets_after_success_and_failure
tests.description: Invocation metadata cannot leak into later Activity calls
tests.arrange: Run successful and failing harness invocations under different canonical skills
tests.act: Inspect context during and after each call
tests.assert: Each call sees only its own skill and context returns to no skill afterward

tests.name: config_resolution_returns_fresh_frozen_profiles
tests.description: Resolved profiles are immutable values and are not shared mutable invocation state
tests.act: Resolve the same skill twice and attempt to mutate a result
tests.assert: Equal fresh frozen profiles are returned and mutation raises FrozenInstanceError
